item.title: Two Next-Gen Spotlight Awards at ICRA 2026 in Vienna
item.author: (Markus Knauer)
item.description: Our research on natural language-driven robot skill selection and adaptation received two Next-Gen Spotlight Awards at IEEE ICRA 2026 in Vienna, recognizing the CLASP and IROSA frameworks.
